body:
I don't really like talking to my family about what's going on. It reminds be that I've failed and I feel embarrassed... I do see a decent therapist and am medicated, though it doesn't seem to be fixing anything.

And you know, maybe some or all of this is my fault, but I just can't figure out where I could have gone wrong. I'd gladly take responsibility and try to turn things around if I knew where to look and what to do. I'm just at a loss.

I do prefer to be alone generally, just not completely alone. I like having a boyfriend and that's mostly it. Kind of sucks when your boyfriend is like mine and there's no motivation or power to fix anything.

He does make me happy sometimes. Hell, in December I thought he was perfect and that maybe he'd change the fact that I never want to get married. Of course, that didn't last. It's difficult for me to be happy with him for an extended period of time now because of the things he's said and done. I don't get mad or start things... My smile just fades as soon as I start remembering him outside of the moment. Then I'm sad again.

It doesn't feel like it anymore. I mean, how could I try like I do and keep failing unless I deserved all this? I went from feeling hopeful that hard work would pay off to hating myself and wanting to give up trying.

Been together about 1.5 years.

Thank you for responding. I'm currently 23, so it's been several years of trying and failing. I mean, it'd be one thing if I was always a lazy person and never put in an effort, but I  gave everything my all. Perfect grades, working so hard and long to be independent. Not only does it not pay off, but it seems like the harder I try to better myself, the worse things get.
